text: Hormesis is defined as a phenomenon in which a harmful substance gives stimulating and beneficial effects to living organisms when the quantity of the harmful substance is small. <break time="0.8s" /> Exercise is the easiest example of how hormesis works. <break time="0.8s" /> Lets say you have been sedentary for 10 years, and you hear about the benefits of CrossFit. <break time="0.8s" /> CrossFit is a 60 minute, high intensity workout often involving Olympic lifts, burst training, and other functional modalities. <break time="0.8s" /> If you decide that your first workout back into the world of fitness will be a CrossFit one, your body will have a hard time adapting to this stress, you will be sore for days, and you may even hurt yourself. <break time="0.8s" /> You would have done too much and fallen out of your hormetic zone. <break time="0.8s" /> However, if you instead did a 45 minute walk and some push ups, squats, and planks, your body most likely could adapt to this light stress, you would stay within your hormetic zone, and you would grow stronger and healthier. <break time="0.8s" /> You would have found your sweet spot. <break time="0.8s" /> Over time the goal is to create a higher hormetic ceiling, so you can apply more stressors and stay within the zone of benefits.
